'''Caleb Smith''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 10th after Swiss, 11 (+88) at [[2001 Vegas DPC]] on 28 April 2001, according to Geoff Bowman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2191">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-dpc-vegas-socal-viewd2191/ dpc-vegas-socal-view], DeckTech (Geoff "GG BLADE" Bowman, 29 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-dpc-vegas-socal-viewd2191/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
